The '''Nev Ice Flow''' was located on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] built their [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] south of the ice flow. The Nev Ice Flow was located next to the [[Cirque Glacier/Legends|Cirque Glacier]], the [[Lanteel Glacier/Legends|Lanteel Glacier]] and the [[Kerane Valley/Legends|Kerane Valley]]. [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] crossed through the Nev Ice Flow during their attack on Echo Base. [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] were attacked by Rebel [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] in the ice flow.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />
